zh-CN.title: 仓库任务
zh-CN.description: 在隔离工作区运行 Agent 并审阅 Git 改动。

usage.title: 关联仓库
usage.description: 在普通 Agent 对话顶部打开仓库，粘贴 GitHub 地址或选择已导入的仓库。

usage.title: 审阅提交
usage.description: 检查测试报告和 Git 差异，再确认推送贡献分支。

usage.title: 提交 PR
usage.description: 打开 GitHub 上已填入标题和正文的表单，并在 GitHub 提交。

en-US.title: Repository tasks
en-US.description: Run an Agent in an isolated worktree and review its Git changes.

usage.title: Attach a repository
usage.description: Open Repository in a regular Agent conversation, then paste a GitHub URL or select an imported checkout.

usage.title: Review the commit
usage.description: Inspect the test report and Git diff before confirming a push to the contribution branch.

usage.title: Submit the PR
usage.description: Open the prefilled GitHub form and submit the pull request on GitHub.
